description: Generate ONE XLSX spreadsheet from HTML/CSV-ish content or a URL. Test mode by default.

base_url.description: base URL for relative links in the HTML

document_content.description: the HTML/CSV source of the document

document_url.description: a public URL to render instead of inline content

insecure.description: allow self-signed SSL certificates when fetching assets

name.description: document name; also becomes the default file name

save_path.description: path to write the document to

test.description: test documents are free and watermarked

name: docraptor_create_xlsx
